correctness.rationale: An exact cyclic phase expansion for the ones count and 01 count is proved. Distinct full-period 01 counts cannot collide above m>binom(p-1,2); equal counts arise exactly at g-1 gcd coincidences, and their unique nonzero-residue equal-ones tails have unequal 01 counts. Every period is primitive. The explicit h-family satisfies an exact equality at m=p²/16-1, demonstrating a quadratic lower bound on any universal stabilization threshold. Direct independent checker comparisons passed: 1176 full-signature checks, 7488 direct-window arithmetic checks, 576 full-period checks, 83700 eventual-spectrum checks, and 40 quadratic collision witnesses; finite experiments do not prove the theorem.
